Privacy Policy

Effective date: September 2026

Information We Collect

We collect data you provide voluntarily (e.g., name, phone, address) when you place an order or contact us. We also store cart data in your browser’s local storage.

We use your information solely to fulfill orders, communicate order status, and improve our services. We never sell your data to third parties.

Data Security

All personal data is stored in an encrypted SQLite database on our server. Communications are protected via HTTPS.

Your Rights

You may request deletion of your personal data by contacting us at Sumit@celestialgood.com.
